newsitem.title: USA: Wells Fargo stake cut by Berkshire.
newsitem.headline: Wells Fargo stake cut by Berkshire.

text.p: Berkshire Hathaway Inc said it cut its stake in Wells Fargo and Co to 6,996,418 common shares or about 7.6 percent from eight percent previously held, according to a regulatory filing released May 14.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Berkshire, headed by Omaha, Neb., billionaire Warren Buffett, said its latest transactions include the sale of about 323,000 shares between February 14 and March 31, 1997.
Buffett's previous holdings of 7,319,418 common were disclosed in Wells Fargo's most recent proxy statement.
At 1300 EDT, Wells Fargo was trading on the New York Stock Exchange at $264 per share, down 3-7/8.
Wells Fargo is based in San Francisco, Calif.
